rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rbin is a binary analysis server providing radare2-backed disassembly and decompilation, Ghidra integration for advanced control flow analysis, and native tools for PE, ELF, and Mach-O file parsing. Analysis capabilities include security hardening checks, call graph analysis, entropy analysis, capability detection, and fuzzing suggestions. Outputs are designed for compact token usage to minimize LLM context cost during analysis workflows.
